```{r}
#| include: false
# Build-time setup for static (non-interactive) code chunks
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

```{webr}
#| include: false
# In-browser setup: mirror the original learnr checker, which always marked
# an attempt as correct and showed the message written in the *-check chunk.
options(webr.exercise.checker = function(label, user_code, check_code, ...) {
  if (is.null(check_code)) return(invisible(NULL))
  msg <- eval(parse(text = check_code))
  # light markdown: `code` and --- (em dash), as learnr rendered them
  msg <- gsub("`([^`]+)`", "<code>\\1</code>", msg)
  msg <- gsub("---", "&mdash;", msg, fixed = TRUE)
  list(
    message = htmltools::HTML(msg),
    correct = TRUE,
    location = "append"
  )
})
```
